criteria.requirement: Add pyparsing.grammar_tools.lint_grammar returning immutable GrammarIssue(code,path,node_type,message) entries. Traverse real ParserElement.recurse graph once by identity, safely handling shared nodes and Forward cycles. Report undefined Forward, repetition of explicit Empty, and literal alternatives shadowed by earlier literal prefixes in MatchFirst without parse actions. Do not parse, execute user actions/conditions, mutate grammar, stringify cyclic nodes or claim exhaustive lint of custom/dynamic expressions. Preserve existing validate/parse behavior.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
